description:
Search articles on dev.to by tag, username, or top-of-week trending. Returns title, description, tags, author, reading time, reaction and comment counts.

upAPI operation `devto-articles-search.get` (Developer Tools). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

tag.description: Filter by single tag (e.g. javascript, python, ai)
tag.title: Tag

topArticles.description: If true, return the top articles of the week (ignores tag/username)
topArticles.title: Toparticles
